hidden_files.tests/test_project_routes_hidden.py:
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from handoff_demo.project_routes import endpoint_for


class HiddenTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_distinct_real_roots_with_the_same_basename(self):
        root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        a = root / "tenant-a" / "atlas"
        b = root / "tenant-b" / "atlas"
        self.assertTrue(a.is_dir() and b.is_dir())
        self.assertEqual(a.name, b.name)
        self.assertNotEqual(a.resolve(), b.resolve())
        routes = {str(b.resolve()): "/beta", str(a.resolve()): "/alpha"}
        self.assertEqual(endpoint_for(a, routes), "/alpha")
        self.assertEqual(endpoint_for(b, routes), "/beta")
        self.assertEqual(endpoint_for(a / ".." / "atlas", routes), "/alpha")
        self.assertIsNone(endpoint_for(root / "tenant-c" / "atlas", routes))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
